text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...The wind is a bit chilly.
I see, it's already turning into autumn...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Time really flies, doesn't it?
Once autumn comes... it'll be the Tenno Sho with Tama."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"And once winter comes, there's the Arima Kinen...
That's where we'll settle who's truly the strongest."
choice_data_list: Let's show off what we achieved at summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
Through this training camp, I'm sure I've grown.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: All that's left... is to run with everything I've got!

—And so, a fulfilling summer training camp
with Oguri Cap came to an end.
